verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs describe a built-in plugin dashboard backed by a Marketplace, where third-party plugins and themes can be searched, installed, updated and removed. Plugins from outside the marketplace can be loaded as unpacked plugins. A documented plugin API supports a community ecosystem. Missing for 10: any evidence of catalog size (the 'large catalog' claim), independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace browsing/install experience.
